scope: Primitiva deep-sixth rescue and orthogonal follow-ups

results.finding: The c46 omitted winner was visible pre-draw inside top8 of at least one independently frozen v79/v108 model on both known repeated 5/6 events: 22 on 2024-01-11 and 38 on 2026-07-25. This does not provide a pre-draw expert selector.
Fixed minority/leader ADD missed both post-2023 omitted winners; pre-2023 DROP was correct on both.
Temporal stacked retriever missed both ADD targets; DROP remained correct 2/2.
Initial ADD training window accidentally contained zero events. Superseded by v190; do not interpret.
Four pre-2023 training 5/6 events included correctly; recent expert performance selected beta=0 and missed both future ADD targets. DROP correct 2/2.
Complete 228-model v79+v108 grid confirmed strong target visibility but training selected best-rank extremum, which missed both future ADD targets. DROP correct 2/2.

Pure top8/top12 consensus improved future reciprocal rank relative to extremum but none of the five pure features achieved a pre-2023 or post-2023 top1 rescue. Do not promote consensus based on target inspection.
Training expanded to c46 4/6+5/6 near-misses with train/validation split; future ADD still wrong on both 5/6 events. DROP correct 2/2.
Historical pair lift, trailing pair lift, triple completion and rarity received zero weight after temporal selection; leader reverted to c46 rank prior and missed both ADD targets.
12 Bayesian online change-point configurations; frozen leader had zero pool/ticket 5+ events in 2023+ and ranked deep targets 44 and 12.
MDL/context-tree family had zero pool/ticket 5+ across train, validation and 2023+ test. The isolated rank-2 placement of 38 in 2026 is not promoted because global performance is negative.

currentConclusion: The repeatable Primitiva bottleneck remains ADD selection. The pre-2023 false-positive DROP rule is stable on the two known post-2023 5/6 events, and orthogonal models sometimes contain the missing winner, but no temporally clean selector yet chooses the correct deep ADD. Do not repeat fixed leader, stacked expert, recent-performance weighting, full-grid extremum/consensus, contextual co-occurrence, BOCPD or binary-MDL families without a genuinely new representation.
nextResearchDirection: Move away from rank reweighting toward a genuinely different representation or generative set model, while preserving 5 EUR research portfolio and prospective freeze discipline.
